cohort: Patients admitted to all hospitals in Sierra Leone known to perform inpatient surgery
finding: There was a 51% decrease in weekly median non-Ebola admissions and 41% fewer weekly median surgeries performed during the first year of the EVD outbreak compared with the 20 weeks before the outbreak and 2012, respectively.
mod_finding: Governmental hospitals realized an increased volume of cesarean deliveries by 45% during the EVD outbreak, thereby absorbing the 43% reduction observed in the private non-profit hospitals.
